rules.heading: 1. Store manager
rules.statement: May approve a purchase order up to INR 40,000 against a supplier with terms in force.

rules.heading: 2. Owner
rules.statement: Required for any order above INR 40,000, any order against a supplier with no terms in force, and any order placed outside the agreed lead time.

rules.heading: 3. Automated drafting
rules.statement: A system may draft a purchase order. It may not place one. Every draft expires if not approved, and re-validates its prices before execution.
